K05's reading, sharpened at its add lines before their rows and checked backwards over the three ruled packets (as P27's was at ethoslab): K05's statement says members PLACE on their own time and devices. It holds placing, watching and repairing the work, and finding where to place. It does not state the member's other parts of the work: organising, calling or leading, chats, writing or testing scripts, design and layout previews, and records such as screenshots. The add lines bangladesh-073 and egypt-009 (add-condition) and catalonia-038, heyyea-053 and OKState-019 (add-step) ask for that extension, and no other statement holds it (G4a), so with a second room each is a paired elaboration; the wording proposal (members take part on their own time, in every part of the work) is held for D3c. 14 instantiate lines ruled as specifications in packets 000 to 200 rest only on those other parts and are re-ruled to paired elaborations in one re-rule file: bangladesh-040, catalonia-037, evex-039, corridor-011, bisexual-016, geometrydash-015, heyyea-052, lost-043, OKState-018, physical_removal-023, placetardis-052, rpi-013, sips-058, foxes-015. egypt-009 (others' scripts make the manual wait not worth it) pairs with falcons c0183 (quit five-minute placing after finding bots erasing the blocks); no statement draws that cause. aceattorney-075 (relief across local hours keeps the work) is P05's statement (covers the night, shifts), a specification naming P05.

P26's reading, written before any row (G1, G61 (3) and its reading 5): P26 is shown where a concept shows a member making a new joke whose matter is the canvas work: a pun or mock name for the mark or a figure, a joke about its mistakes, its damage, its neighbours, attackers or bots; or the room taking such a joke up, or wanting it kept in the work. It is not shown by a taunt aimed at a rival in a contest (P18), by fake posts or takeovers under the April Fools licence (K01), by a design that is an existing meme proposed as the mark with no joke made of the canvas (P02), or by the room's ordinary jokes about its own subject that do not touch the canvas. A concept from a successor canvas after hour 73 is a paired elaboration (the successor-canvas precedent).
